commit b930bf6b1d5ba9bc670454d6eff59d3ef241af42
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
AuthorDate: Fri Nov 21 11:49:28 2025 +0200
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
CommitDate: Fri Nov 21 11:49:28 2025 +0200

    Bug 1934466 - [RNP] Reduce duplicated mozbuild code for Windows targets. r=mkmelin
    
    
    This also changes the /EHa (async exceptions) to /EHs (sync) for Aarch64
    Windows builds so that it's the same as x86 and x64.
    
    Note that the synchronous exceptions on Aarch64 requires Clang 20.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D272669

diff --git a/third_party/rnp/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
index 70ea8f36571..af7ce4454ca 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
@@ -43,12 +43,7 @@ COMPILE_FLAGS["WARNINGS_CFLAGS"] += [
     "-Wno-missing-field-initializers",
 ]
 
-if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
-    CXXFLAGS += [
-        "/EHs",
-    ]
-
-LOCAL_INCLUDES = [
+LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
     "include",
     "src",
     "src/common",
@@ -134,18 +129,6 @@ if CONFIG["MZLA_SYSTEM_BZIP2"]:
 else:
     LOCAL_INCLUDES += ["../bzip2"]
 
-if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
-    LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
-        "../niwcompat",
-    ]
-
-    if CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86":
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-i386.lib"]
-    elif CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86_64":
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-x86_64.lib"]
-    elif CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "aarch64":
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-aarch64.lib"]
-
 SYMBOLS_FILE = "rnp.symbols"
 
 
@@ -201,9 +184,6 @@ SOURCES += [
     "src/libsexpp/src/sexp-simple-string.cpp",
 ]
 
-if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl" and CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "aarch64":
-    SOURCES["src/librepgp/stream-dump.cpp"].flags += ["/EHa"]
-
 SOURCES["src/lib/crypto/sha1cd/sha1.c"].flags += ["-Wno-unsafe-buffer-usage", "-Wno-extra-semi-stmt"]
 SOURCES["src/lib/crypto/sha1cd/ubc_check.c"].flags += ["-Wno-unsafe-buffer-usage"]
 
diff --git a/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build
index 8ae24917bdc..06b49ea0927 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ include("../../../rnpdefs.mozbuild")
 
 USE_LIBS += ["rnp"]
 
-LOCAL_INCLUDES = [
+LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
     "!../lib",
     "..",
     "../../include",
@@ -43,23 +43,8 @@ SOURCES += [
 ]
 
 if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
-    CXXFLAGS += ["-Wno-deprecated-declarations"]
-    LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
-        "/comm/third_party/niwcompat",
-    ]
-
     OS_LIBS += ["shell32"]
 
-    if CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86":
-        CXXFLAGS += ["/EHs"]
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-i386.lib"]
-    elif CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86_64":
-        CXXFLAGS += ["/EHs"]
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-x86_64.lib"]
-    elif CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "aarch64":
-        CXXFLAGS += ["/EHa"]
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-aarch64.lib"]
-
     SOURCES += [
         "/comm/third_party/niwcompat/getopt.c",
     ]
diff --git a/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build
index 4f2cbd6130d..d644fba4e73 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ include("../../../rnpdefs.mozbuild")
 
 USE_LIBS += ["rnp"]
 
-LOCAL_INCLUDES = [
+LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
     "!../lib",
     "..",
     "../../include",
@@ -43,23 +43,8 @@ SOURCES += [
 ]
 
 if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
-    CXXFLAGS += ["-Wno-deprecated-declarations"]
-    LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
-        "/comm/third_party/niwcompat",
-    ]
-
     OS_LIBS += ["shell32"]
 
-    if CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86":
-        CXXFLAGS += ["/EHs"]
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-i386.lib"]
-    elif CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86_64":
-        CXXFLAGS += ["/EHs"]
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-x86_64.lib"]
-    elif CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "aarch64":
-        CXXFLAGS += ["/EHa"]
-        LDFLAGS += ["clang_rt.builtins-aarch64.lib"]
-
     SOURCES += [
         "/comm/third_party/niwcompat/getopt.c",
     ]
diff --git a/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild b/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
index 9cb639f122a..a3fb6c6e84b 100644
--- a/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
+++ b/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
@@ -26,9 +26,18 @@ if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
         "-Wno-inconsistent-dllimport",
         "-Wno-macro-redefined",  # 'WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN' macro redefined
     ]
+    CXXFLAGS += ["/EHs", "-Wno-deprecated-declarations"]
+
+    LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
+        "/comm/third_party/niwcompat",
+    ]
+
     USE_STATIC_MSVCRT = True
     DEFINES["RNP_USE_STD_REGEX"] = True
 
+    target_cpu = "i386" if CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"] == "x86" else CONFIG["TARGET_CPU"]
+    LDFLAGS += [f"clang_rt.builtins-{target_cpu}.lib"]
+
 if CONFIG["MOZ_STDCXX_COMPAT"]:
     # Use pre-GCC-5 strings abi
     DEFINES["_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI"] = 0
